items.title: Infant Care
items.desc: Sensory-rich care with constant, attentive supervision.
items.details: Every classroom corner is staffed, camera-monitored, and laid out to keep exploring babies safe.

items.title: Toddler
items.desc: Building language, independence, and first friendships.
items.details: Daily circle time and Montessori-based activities introduce structure through play.

items.title: Early Preschool
items.desc: Structured play that builds focus and cooperation.
items.details: Weekly English & Arabic and Math & Quran sessions build early academic foundations.

items.title: Preschool
items.desc: Getting ready for the next step, one lesson at a time.
items.details: A full weekly rhythm of academics, Montessori, and outdoor play prepares kids for what's next.

items.title: Campers and after schoolers
items.desc: children aged 4–9 are typically part of our After-School Program or seasonal camps, where learning continues beyond the classroom in a fun, engaging, and supportive environment.
items.details:
Our program is designed to keep children active, curious, and socially engaged through a mix of creative activities, educational support, sports, arts & crafts, games, and hands-on experiences.

For after-schoolers, we provide a safe and welcoming space where children can unwind after school, complete their homework, build new skills, and enjoy meaningful activities with their friends.

During our summer and winter camps, children enjoy a more dynamic program filled with themed activities, challenges, outdoor play, creative workshops, and exciting experiences designed around their age group.

Our goal is simple: to give every child a place to learn, play, explore, and grow — even beyond their school day.

items.title: Teens
items.desc: We welcome teens to their own dedicated floor, giving them a space where they can socialize, express themselves, explore their interests, and build amazing memories together.
items.details: With the support of our team, teens enjoy a variety of social activities, creative experiences, games, challenges, and group events designed to encourage confidence, friendship, teamwork, and independence — all while having a great time in a space that feels like their own.
